verdict.rationale: Image generation and editing is a fair question for an AI assistant like Kimi, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents generating or editing images from prompts. The only image-related material covers image understanding (vision input and file analysis) on the API surface, which is a different capability from image generation and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can generate and edit images from natural-language prompts
